Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (4g), Sodium, Iron
Ingredients Required: All-purpose flour (Maida), Oil/Ghee for dough, Onions (finely chopped), Nigella seeds (Kalonji), Fennel seeds (Saunf), Coriander seeds, Garam masala, Amchur, Gram flour (Besan), Deep frying oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare stiff dough using maida, oil, salt, and water. 2. Sauté crushed coriander, saunf, onions, besan, and spices until dry. 3. Stuff dough balls with onion mixture, flatten slightly, and deep fry on low flame until golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: All-purpose flour (Maida), Ghee, Green peas (Matar - coarsely crushed), Green chillies, Saunf (Fennel), Amchur powder, Hing (Asafoetida), Coriander seeds, Oil for deep frying, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare stiff dough with maida, ghee, salt, and water. 2. Sauté coarsely crushed green peas with crushed saunf, coriander seeds, hing, amchur, green chillies, and salt until dry. 3. Stuff dough balls with spicy matar filling, seal edges, and deep fry on slow-medium flame until crisp and golden.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (4g), Vitamin C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Large Bhavnagri green chillies, Boiled potatoes, Besan (Gram flour), Ajwain, Amchur powder, Red chilli powder, Garam masala, Salt, Oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slit large green chillies and deseed. 2. Mix boiled mashed potatoes with spices, salt, and amchur. Stuff inside chillies and layer potato mash outside. 3. Dip in thick seasoned besan batter and deep fry until golden brown.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Bajra flour (Pearl millet), Whole wheat flour, Fresh fenugreek leaves (Methi), Green chilli paste, Sesame seeds, Carom seeds (Ajwain), Vegetable oil, Warm water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead bajra flour, wheat flour, chopped methi, spices, and warm water into a tight dough. 2. Roll small flat circles. 3. Deep fry in hot vegetable oil until puffed and crisp. Serve hot with pickle.

Key Nutrients: Protein (22g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (4g), Collagen, Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Mutton trotters (Kharode), Whole spices (Cinnamon, Cloves, Black cardamom, Peppercorns), Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Mustard oil, Salt, Lemon juice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Clean and blanch mutton trotters. 2. Heat oil, add crushed ginger, garlic, onions, and whole spices. 3. Add trotters and water; pressure cook for 45-60 minutes on low heat until collagen breaks down into a rich broth. Strain and garnish with lemon juice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (30g), Carbohydrates (75g), Fiber (10g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Toor dal, Chana dal, Moong dal, Whole wheat flour, Semolina (Sooji), Ghee, Sugar/Jaggery, Cardamom, Panch phoron, Green chillies, Spices
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead wheat flour, sooji, ghee, and water; shape into balls (Baati) and bake, then soak in ghee. 2. Pressure cook mixed lentils with turmeric and salt; temper with ghee and spices (Dal). 3. Crush baked baatis, mix with melted ghee, sugar, and cardamom (Churma).

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (29g), Carbohydrates (75g), Fiber (10g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Toor dal, Chana dal, Moong dal (Strictly without onion/garlic/roots), Whole wheat flour, Sooji, Ghee, Jaggery/Sugar, Hing, Cumin seeds, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Green chillies
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead wheat flour, sooji, ghee into tight dough, shape into baatis and bake until golden; dip in ghee. 2. Cook mixed lentils, temper in ghee with cumin seeds, green chillies, hing, and turmeric (no root vegetables). 3. Crush baked baatis, mix with ghee, cardamom, and sugar.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Besan (Gram flour), Curd (Yogurt), Ghee, Ajwain, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Mustard seeds, Cumin seeds, Hing
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead besan with spices, oil, and water into a stiff dough; roll into cylinders, boil, cool, and slice into gatte. 2. Whisk curd with spices. Heat ghee, temper with mustard and cumin, add curd mixture, stir continuously, then simmer gatte in gravy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (17g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Besan (Gram flour), Sour curd, Ghee, Hing (Asafoetida), Ajwain, Cumin seeds, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Saunf, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare besan dough with ajwain, salt, ghee, and water. Roll into cylinders, boil until cooked, and slice. 2. Whisk sour curd with turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and hing. 3. Heat ghee, add cumin and hing, pour spiced curd mixture, stir continuously on low heat till oil separates, add gatte and simmer.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (20g), Fiber (9g), Iron, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Ker (Dried desert berries), Sangri (Dried desert beans), Mustard oil, Amchur, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Cumin seeds, Raisins
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak dried Ker and Sangri overnight; boil until tender. 2. Heat mustard oil, add cumin seeds and hing. 3. Add boiled Ker-Sangri with spices, amchur, and raisins. Sauté on low heat for 10 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (20g), Fiber (9g), Iron, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Ker berries, Sangri beans, Ghee or Oil, Hing, Cumin seeds, Whole red chillies, Amchur powder, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak Ker and Sangri overnight, boil with salt and turmeric until soft. 2. Heat ghee/oil, temper cumin seeds and generous hing (no garlic/onion used). 3. Add berries and beans, toss with dry spices and amchur powder, cook on low heat for 10 mins.

Key Nutrients: Protein (34g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (2g), Fiber (1g), Iron, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Mutton (Goat meat), Pure Desi Ghee, Mathania whole dry red chillies, Garlic, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat generous ghee in a heavy brass/iron handi. 2. Add whole Mathania dry red chillies and crushed garlic. 3. Add mutton pieces and salt. Slow cook on low heat in its own juices and ghee for 1.5 to 2 hours until tender.

Key Nutrients: Protein (36g), Fat (38g), Carbohydrates (8g), Fiber (1g), Calcium, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Mutton, Fresh cream, Whisked curd, Cashew paste, Poppy seeds paste, Ghee, Green cardamom, Cloves, White pepper powder, Milk
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate mutton in curd and ginger-garlic paste. 2. Heat ghee, temper with green cardamom and cloves. 3. Sauté meat gently, then add cashew paste, poppy seeds paste, milk, and white pepper. Simmer on low heat until velvety white gravy forms and meat tenderizes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (7g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Chana dal (Bengal gram), Coarsely ground black pepper, Cumin seeds, Green chillies, Ginger, Fennel seeds, Coriander leaves, Vegetable oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak chana dal for 4 hours and grind coarsely without water. 2. Mix with green chillies, ginger, saunf, and spices. Shape into thick discs and deep fry until half cooked. 3. Slice discs into strips and re-fry until ultra-crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (7g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Chana dal, Whole black pepper, Cumin seeds, Green chillies, Fennel seeds (Saunf), Hing (Asafoetida), Salt, Oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak chana dal for 4 hours; coarsely grind without ginger. 2. Add crushed saunf, peppercorns, cumin, hing, green chillies, and salt. 3. Shape into thick round patties, half fry, cool, slice into strips, and deep fry again till extra crispy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (2g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Maida, Ghee, Mawa (Khoya), Nuts (Almonds, Pistachios), Cardamom powder, Sugar, Saffron sugar syrup
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare crisp maida crust pastry using ghee moyan. 2. Sauté mawa with chopped nuts, cardamom, and sugar for filling. 3. Stuff pastry, deep fry in ghee until golden, break open top, and pour warm saffron sugar syrup inside.

Key Nutrients: Protein (35g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Mutton (Lamb/Goat meat), Mathania red chillies, Mustard oil, Curd (Yogurt), Garlic paste, Whole spices, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind soaked Mathania chillies into paste. 2. Heat mustard oil, temper whole spices, sauté onions and mutton. 3. Add garlic paste, chilli paste, and whisked curd. Slow cook until meat is tender and red oil separates.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (8g), Omega-3, Iodine, Vitamin D
Ingredients Required: Freshwater fish (Sole/Rohu), Mustard oil, Amchur powder, Mustard seeds paste, Garlic, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Cumin seeds, Fenugreek seeds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate fish with turmeric, red chilli, and salt; shallow fry in mustard oil. 2. In same oil, temper cumin and fenugreek seeds, add mustard-garlic paste, tomato puree, and amchur. 3. Simmer sauce, add fried fish, and cook for 8 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Besan, Mawa (Khoya), Paneer, Nuts, Curd, Ghee, Shahi Jeera, Garam masala, Cashew paste, Tomato puree, Spices
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix mawa, crumbled paneer, and chopped nuts for stuffing. 2. Roll besan dough around stuffing to make stuffed gattas; boil and deep fry. 3. Cook rich curd and cashew gravy in ghee, add stuffed gattas, and simmer.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Besan, Paneer, Mawa, Chopped almonds & pistachios, Curd, Cashew paste, Ghee, Shahi jeera, Hing, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Stuff besan dough balls with a mixture of paneer, mawa, and nuts. Boil, drain, and shallow fry in ghee. 2. Prepare gravy by whisking curd with cashew paste, hing, and dry spices. Cook in ghee until oil separates. 3. Simmer stuffed gattas in gravy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (20g), Fiber (4g), Sodium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Urad dal papad, Vegetable oil, Cumin seeds, Mustard seeds, Hing, Turmeric, Red chilli powder, Coriander powder, Amchur powder, Tomato puree / Water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roast or shallow fry urad dal papads and break into large pieces. 2. Heat vegetable oil, temper cumin, mustard, and hing. 3. Add tomato puree (or water mix) with dry spices and bring to a boil. 4. Turn off heat, toss in papad pieces, cover for 2 minutes and serve immediately.

Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (9g), Carbohydrates (24g), Fiber (5g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Moong dal mangodi (sun-dried lentil dumplings), Moong/Urad papad, Whisked curd, Ghee, Hing, Cumin seeds, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Coriander powder, Kasuri methi
Recipe Instructions: 1. Shallow fry mangodi in ghee till golden; pressure cook with water until soft. 2. Heat ghee, temper cumin seeds and hing. Add whisked curd mixed with spices and stir continuously until boiling. 3. Add cooked mangodi and roasted papad pieces. Simmer for 5 minutes and sprinkle kasuri methi.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (8g), Magnesium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Bajra flour (Pearl millet), Warm water, Vegetable oil (or Ghee for veg version), Garlic cloves, Whole dry red chillies, Cumin seeds, Lemon juice, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead bajra flour with warm water; flatten into thick rotis and cook on clay tawa. 2. Grind garlic, red chillies, cumin seeds, salt, and lemon juice into coarse red chutney. Sauté chutney in oil/ghee.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (26g), Carbohydrates (68g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Maida, Solid Ghee, Cold Ice Water, Milk, Sugar (for syrup), Saffron, Cardamom powder, Chopped nuts (Almonds, Pistachios)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk ghee with ice until fluffy; mix milk, maida, ice water to make runny batter. 2. Pour into deep hot ghee from height to form honeycomb mesh disc. 3. Soak disc in warm sugar syrup and top with saffron and nuts.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Khoya/Mawa, Maida, Milk, Saunf (Fennel seeds), Ghee for frying, Sugar syrup (flavored with Cardamom and Saffron), Pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix khoya, maida, saunf, and milk into smooth batter. 2. Fry small pancakes in flat pan with ghee until edges turn golden crisp. 3. Soak in warm cardamom-saffron sugar syrup.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (54g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Yellow Moong dal (soaked and coarsely ground), Desi Ghee, Milk, Sugar, Cardamom powder, Saffron strands, Almonds and Pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slow roast ground moong dal paste in generous ghee on low heat until golden brown and aromatic (30-40 mins). 2. Add warm milk and saffron water; cook till absorbed. 3. Add sugar and cardamom, stirring continuously until ghee separates.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (3g), Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Coarse Besan (Gram flour), Desi Ghee, Milk, Sugar syrup (1.5 string), Cardamom powder, Mawa (Khoya), Slivered almonds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Moisten besan with milk and ghee (Moyan) and pass through a sieve. 2. Roast coarse besan in ghee until golden. 3. Mix in mawa and warm 1.5-string sugar syrup. 4. Pour onto a greased tray, set, top with nuts, and cut into diamond squares.
